name: Universal TV Quick Scroll Buttons
description: Adds top/bottom quick scroll buttons visible in the corner for TV remote

params.code: var container = document.createElement('div'); container.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:20px;left:20px;z-index:99999;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;'; var topBtn = document.createElement('button'); topBtn.textContent = 'Top'; topBtn.style.cssText = 'width:60px;height:40px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(88,166,255,0.85);color:#fff;border:none;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);'; topBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'}); }); var botBtn = document.createElement('button'); botBtn.textContent = 'End'; botBtn.style.cssText = 'width:60px;height:40px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(88,166,255,0.85);color:#fff;border:none;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);'; botBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { window.scrollTo({top:document.documentElement.scrollHeight,behavior:'smooth'}); }); container.appendChild(topBtn); container.appendChild(botBtn); document.body.appendChild(container); return 'quick-scroll-ready';
